summary: Known issue in community.docker: when docker_container attaches a network after container creation, a MAC address set for that network may be ignored by the Docker daemon.
questions: Why is the MAC address I set in docker_container networks not applied?
Does Docker ignore mac_address when a network is attached later?

answer_card.title: docker_container network MAC address ignored
answer_card.answer_md: Known issue: if `docker_container` sets a MAC address for a network that is attached **after** the container is created (for example during idempotency handling), the Docker daemon may ignore it. Attaching the network at creation time avoids the problem.
